items.t: Piper Sandler Maintains Neutral on Lemonade, Lowers Price Target to $37

items.t: Where Lemonade Goes After A 53% Drop
items.sum: If you had decided on 1 January 2026 that Lemonade’s AI-heavy insurance pitch was just too risky and moved on, the outcome might look different today. For Lemonade shareholders, the loss from the start of the year was 53.3%, including dividends.
